name: onboarding-audit
description: Sign up for your product as a new user every month, by persona, and get a ranked friction report with screenshots, time to value and prefilled tickets for GitHub, Linear or Jira.

interface.longDescription: Signs up for your product the way a new customer would, for each persona you define, and reports where people get stuck: ranked by what actually happened, with screenshots, measured waits, estimated hands-on time, and one-click prefilled tickets for GitHub, Linear or Jira. Never types passwords or codes, and stops before payment unless you set a discount link.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run an onboarding audit of my product
